32431-the-model-of-a-judge.title: The Model Of A Judge
32431-the-model-of-a-judge.creator: Unknown
32431-the-model-of-a-judge.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He could hear every conversation taking place in ordinary tones in the large reception room. When he concentrated he could make out the whispers. At this point he had to concentrate, for Mrs. Claymore leaned over and breathed into her friend's attentive ear.

arxiv-1904-08108.title: Squared eigenfunction symmetry of the D Δ \Delta mKP hierarchy and its constraint
arxiv-1904-08108.creator: Kui Chen, Cheng Zhang, Da-jun Zhang
arxiv-1904-08108.description: Abstract In this paper squared eigenfunction symmetry of the differential-difference modified Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (D Δ \Delta mKP) hierarchy and its constraint are considered. Under the constraint, the Lax triplets of the D Δ \Delta mKP hierarchy, together with their adjoint forms, give rise to the positive relativistic Toda (R-Toda) hierarchy.

arxiv-2207-11723.title: On the Validation of Multi-Level Personalised Health Condition Model
arxiv-2207-11723.creator: Najma Taimoor, Semeen Rehman
arxiv-2207-11723.description: Abstract This paper presents a verification-based methodology to validate the model of personalised health conditions. The model identifies the values that may result in unsafe, unreachable, in-exhaustive, and overlapping states threaten otherwise threaten the patient’s life by producing false alarms by accepting suspicious behaviour of the target health condition.

arxiv-2308-13284.title: Integrability of a Family of Lotka–Volterra Three Species Biological System
arxiv-2308-13284.creator: Aween Karim 1 , Azad Amen 1,2,3,4 and Waleed Aziz 5
arxiv-2308-13284.description: Abstract . The aim of this study is to analyze the integrability problem of Lotka–Volterra three species biological system. The system which considered in this work is a biological plausibility or a chemical model. The system has a complex dynamical behavior because it is chaotic system.

arxiv-2309-05628.title: Collisions between kinks with long-range tails: a simple and efficient method
arxiv-2309-05628.creator: João G. F. Campos, Azadeh Mohammadi
arxiv-2309-05628.description: Abstract We construct initial configurations for the scattering between kinks with long-range tails. For this purpose, we exploit kink solutions in the presence of Bogomol’nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS)-preserving impurities. This approach offers a highly efficient method and effortless implementation with a negligible computational cost.

arxiv-2504-16443.title: Marginalized Generalized IoU (MGIoU): A Unified Objective Function for Optimizing Any Convex Parametric Shapes
arxiv-2504-16443.creator: Duy-Tho Le, Trung Pham, Jianfei Cai, Hamid Rezatofighi
arxiv-2504-16443.description: Abstract Optimizing the similarity between parametric shapes is crucial for numerous computer vision tasks, where Intersection over Union (IoU) stands as the canonical measure. However, existing optimization methods exhibit significant shortcomings: regression-based losses like L1/L2 lack correlation with IoU, IoU-based losses are unstable and limited to simple shapes, and task-specific methods are computationally intensive and not generalizable across domains.

arxiv-2507-14734.title: Basis partitions and their signature Thanks: Research supported in part by NSA Grants MSPF-06G-150 and MSPF-08G-154
arxiv-2507-14734.creator: Krishnaswami Alladi
arxiv-2507-14734.description: Abstract . Basis partitions are minimal partitions corresponding to successive rank vectors. We show combinatorially how basis partitions can be generated from primary partitions which are equivalent to the Rogers-Ramanujan partitions. This leads to the definition of a signature of a basis partition that we use to explain certain parity results.

arxiv-2511-10436.title: Preference Elicitation for Step-Wise Explanations in Logic Puzzles
arxiv-2511-10436.creator: Marco Foschini, Marianne Defresne, Emilio Gamba, Bart Bogaerts, Tias Guns
arxiv-2511-10436.description: Abstract Step-wise explanations can explain logic puzzles and other satisfaction problems by showing how to derive decisions step by step. Each step consists of a set of constraints that derive an assignment to one or more decision variables. However, many candidate explanation steps exist, with different sets of constraints and different decisions they derive.

pmc-12382105.title: Multifaceted role of Moringa oleifera leaf extract as antimicrobial, growth enhancer and mitigator of salt stress in tomato seedlings
pmc-12382105.creator: Reda E. Abdelhameed, Doaa A. Galilah, Rabab A. Metwally
pmc-12382105.description: Research on Moringa oleifera L.‘s potential applications as a dietary supplement, medicinal herb and plant growth enhancer under biotic and abiotic stresses has increased recently. Our study aimed to investigate the phytochemical screening of Moringa leaf aqueous extract (MLAE) and to determine its antimicrobial activity against pathogenic bacteria and fungi.

pmc-12656943.title: Shaping Antitumor Immunity with Peptide Vaccines: Implications of Immune Modulation at the Vaccine Site
pmc-12656943.creator: Amrita Sarkar, Emily Pauline Rabinovich, Craig Lee Slingluff, José de la Fuente, José Manuel Pérez De La Lastra
pmc-12656943.description: Cancer vaccines have emerged as a class of therapeutics designed to harness the immune system to stimulate durable anti-tumor responses with lower systemic toxicity than conventional therapies. Many platforms have been explored, including protein, peptide, DNA, RNA, and cell-based vaccines. Within this landscape, peptide vaccines remain a promising approach.

pmc-12708752.title: Benefit/risk balance of prone positioning as first line treatment for upper airway obstruction in Robin sequence
pmc-12708752.creator: Pauline Adnot, Nancy Vegas, Laurianne Coutier, Christèle Gras Leguen, Agnès Giuseppi, Yann Aubineau, Sonia Khirani, Véronique Soupre, Romain Luscan, Brigitte Fauroux, Véronique Abadie
pmc-12708752.description: Robin sequence (RS) is a rare condition associating retrognathia and glossoptosis causing upper airway obstruction. For half of the teams, prone positioning (PP) is the first-line treatment considering the benefit experienced on breathing, sleep, and neurodevelopmental outcome of infants with RS. However, this strategy is debated because of the risk of sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS) associated with PP.

pmc-12788349.title: Magnetic Barkhausen Noise Sensor: A Comprehensive Review of Recent Advances in Non-Destructive Testing and Material Characterization
pmc-12788349.creator: Polyxeni Vourna, Pinelopi P. Falara, Aphrodite Ktena, Evangelos V. Hristoforou, Nikolaos D. Papadopoulos
pmc-12788349.description: Magnetic Barkhausen noise (MBN) represents a powerful non-destructive testing and material characterization methodology enabling quantitative assessment of microstructural features, mechanical properties, and stress states in ferromagnetic materials. This comprehensive review synthesizes recent advances spanning theoretical foundations, sensor design, signal processing methodologies, and industrial applications.

pmc-13205069.title: Mental Disorders as Risk Factors for New Onset Cardiovascular Diseases
pmc-13205069.creator: Agata Anna Sakowicz-Hriscu, Oliwia Grunwald, Paweł Muszyński, Marcin Kożuch, Sławomir Dobrzycki
pmc-13205069.description: Introduction: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are a vast and widespread problem around the world, responsible for around one third of global deaths, of which 85% were due to heart attack and stroke in 2022. There are a lot of well-established risk factors for CVDs, including smoking, diabetes mellitus, obesity, poor diet, alcohol use, and sedentary lifestyle.
